legacy_root.title: Extract progressive-disclosure patterns for very large capability catalogs
legacy_root.question: How do large-catalog systems (IDE command palettes, large API surfaces, plugin ecosystems) reveal capability progressively, and which pattern keeps a 500-item catalog usable without loading it all?
legacy_root.canonical_mechanism: Index-then-hydrate: publish a lightweight catalog entry (command id + title in package.json) so the palette can list the capability without loading the implementation; hydrate the handler only on invoke via implicit onCommand activation (VS Code >= 1.74).

the extension will be activated and `registerCommand` will bind
complete set of commands shows up as result

patterns.name: Index-then-hydrate (IDE command palette / plugin contributions)
patterns.canonical_mechanism: Index-then-hydrate: publish a lightweight catalog entry (command id + title in package.json) so the palette can list the capability without loading the implementation; hydrate the handler only on invoke via implicit onCommand activation (VS Code >= 1.74).
patterns.usable_at_500_basis: observed catalog is larger than 500; a pattern working at 140220 is evidence it can keep 500 usable. The converse (proven at 50 => works at 500) is rejected by this unit.

patterns.name: Search-and-page (plugin ecosystem registry)
patterns.canonical_mechanism: Search-and-page: never materialise the catalog; return a bounded page (npm registry search size default 20, max 250) plus a total count, and let the client iterate with `from`.
patterns.usable_at_500_basis: query matched 2522 packages; API max page size is 250, so a 500-item result cannot be loaded in one payload and does not need to be.

patterns.name: Aggregated index (large API surface)
patterns.canonical_mechanism: Collapse N group-version discovery documents into two aggregated endpoints (/api and /apis).
patterns.usable_at_500_basis: Observed at 61 documents. Per this unit, a pattern proven below 500 is not evidence at 500.

breaking_point.name: Unaggregated per-group-version discovery
breaking_point.why: KEP-3352 states unaggregated discovery can require up to 80 individual requests and is a source of latency and throttling. The live GitHub API listing of kubernetes v1.32.2 OpenAPI v3 files contains 61 documents — the same partition shape. npm search independently refuses pages above 250. Both are eager-dump / per-partition load patterns; the KEP number is the named control.

secondary_api_cap.note: API-enforced max `size`; not a UX study.

answer_for_500.statement: A 500-item capability catalog stays usable without loading it all by publishing an index (id + one-line title/description) and hydrating the body/schema/extension only on selection, the VS Code contributes.commands + activate-on-invoke pattern, observed at 140220 marketplace extensions. When even the index must not be fully listed, search-and-page (npm, max 250/page, observed total 2522 on the recorded query) is the fallback. Eager full-document dump is the control that breaks.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Index-then-hydrate: publish a lightweight catalog entry (command id + title in package.json) so the palette can list the capability without loading the implementation; hydrate the handler only on invoke via implicit onCommand activation (VS Code >= 1.74).

source_lineage.snippet: Beginning with VS Code 1.74.0, commands contributed by your extension do not require a corresponding `onCommand` activation event
the extension will be activated and `registerCommand` will bind
complete set of commands shows up as result

claims.strongest_caveat: Catalog size observed is marketplace extensions (140220), not a counted Command Palette row inventory. The contribution-point index is what scales across that plugin ecosystem; this is not a measurement of keystroke latency at 500 commands.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Search-and-page: never materialise the catalog; return a bounded page (npm registry search size default 20, max 250) plus a total count, and let the client iterate with `from`.
claims.strongest_caveat: Live total=2522 is for query 'boost-exact:false', not the entire npm corpus. The page cap of 250 still forbids loading that result set in one payload.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Eager per-partition fetch: one discovery request per group-version. KEP-3352 records this as a request storm (up to 80 requests) and replaces it with two aggregated documents.

source_lineage.snippet: discovery serves two endpoints, while the unaggregated discovery serves a

claims.strongest_caveat: The structured rail counts 61 OpenAPI v3 documents at kubernetes v1.32.2, which is the same order as the KEP's 'up to 80 requests' figure but is not a live apiserver round-trip trace. This size is below 500 and is the breaking-point control, not evidence that aggregated discovery was measured at 500 items.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Shipped MCP tools/list returns a Tool record whose inputSchema is required. Pagination exists, but each listed tool still carries the invocation contract. Official client guidance is to defer injecting those definitions into the model and search first.

source_lineage.snippet: defers injecting them into the model's context

claims.strongest_caveat: This confirms the on-wire shape and the recommended host-side workaround. It does not measure token cost at 500 tools on a live MCP server.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Three-level progressive disclosure for agent skills: name+description always loaded (~100 tokens), SKILL.md body on trigger, bundled files only when referenced.

source_lineage.snippet: install many Skills without context penalty

claims.strongest_caveat: Mechanism is documented on two rails. No skill-catalog item count was observed on this host, so this pattern is not the 500-item size evidence; it is the same index-then-hydrate idea specialised to LLM context.

claims.canonical_mechanism: Open SEP-2636 claims typical 300-2000 tokens per full Tool and that a 200-tool full-schema dump is already unhelped by scope filtering; its prototype reports 5238 tokens for 37 synthetic tools.

source_lineage.snippet: A user with full scopes legitimately holding 200 tools is not helped

claims.strongest_caveat: Single rail: GitHub pull request body, state=open, not merged into the MCP spec. Default REFUTED as measured fact. May not be cited for the 500-item answer.

claims.canonical_mechanism: A controlled 500-item capability catalog was loaded end-to-end on this worktree and timed.
claims.strongest_caveat: No 500-item fixture was executed. Marketplace size 140220 is larger than 500 (large-to-small inference), which is not the same as a 500-item experiment. Single-rail leftover would also be E3.

claims.canonical_mechanism: The inherited 05-ECOSYSTEM-AND-FRONTIER-RESEARCH.md shard on this host corroborates the progressive-disclosure recommendation.

source_lineage.snippet: install many Skills without context penalty

claims.strongest_caveat: Local inputs command-center/sources/REGISTER.md and the Windows harness-restore 05-ECOSYSTEM file are absent on this Linux worktree. Public rails still answer the unit question; the local shard is source-unavailable, not a measured corroboration.
